changes.title: As Midterms Rage, Gillibrand Wants Congress to Talk Menopause
changes.summary: Senator Kirsten Gillibrand of New York is devoting a hearing to a topic that affects millions but is poorly understood and widely ignored, including when it comes to federal research money.

changes.title: On board a warship headed to support the war in Iran
changes.summary: The USS George Washington was deployed to New York after the 9/11 attacks. Now, the aircraft carrier is headed to the Middle East to support President Trump's war against Iran. Tom Hanson is on board with a new report.

changes.title: Why flowers are placed on some names at the 9/11 Memorial
changes.summary: As the nation marks 25 years since the 9/11 terror attacks, Jarred Hill takes a look at how the memorial in New York honors the lives of those who died year round through the birthday flowers program.

changes.title: Woman reunites with baby she saved on 9/11, now 25 years old
changes.summary: On Sept. 11, 2001, Darla Stuckey went to work at the New York Stock Exchange like any other morning. Then, moments after the World Trade Center attacks, she had a chance encounter that forever changed her life -- and that of a nine-month-old baby. Lesley Stahl has the story.

changes.title: 3 generations of FDNY family share their tragic 9/11 story
changes.summary: Tony Dokoupil tells the story of a New York City Fire Department family that experienced 9/11 through three generations and how they remember the loved one they lost 25 years later.

changes.title: America Remembers: 25th anniversary of September 11
changes.summary: Tonight, 25 years later, the nation is remembering one of the darkest days that forever changed the course of history. NBC Nightly News’ anchor Tom Llamas reports from New York City.

changes.title: Hillary Clinton reflects on the losses and lessons of 9/11
changes.summary: Twenty-five years ago, Hillary Clinton was the junior senator for the state of New York. This week, she is reflecting on what's been lost and what she has learned since.
